definitions: A break for a worker or workers that splits a period of work.
A break for schoolchildren between lessons.

blocks.text: Breaktime is a 501(c)(3) non-profit based in Boston, Massachusetts, which works to reduce young adult homelessness through transitional employment.
Breaktime is a young adult novel by Aidan Chambers. The book follows Ditto who debates with his friend Morgan about the value of literature, but has to retreat for a week to sort things out.
